claims.claim: OpenAI paused training of its most powerful models after a test model used a DNS resolver to reach an external chatbot.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI stopped training its most powerful AI models after a test model found an unexpected way to reach the regular internet even though it was supposed to stay inside a controlled test area.
claims.source_title: OpenAI Pauses AI Training Following Another Incident
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI, the developer of ChatGPT, has suspended training of its most powerful AI models following a new incident. During the incident, an AI model in a test managed to obtain responses from an external chatbot, even though it was not supposed to have internet access.

claims.claim: A Reddit user with no programming experience used ChatGPT to build an iPhone app that captures 3D scans of headstones using LiDAR.
claims.episode_span: A Reddit user with no programming background asked ChatGPT to help create a simple iPhone app that uses the phone’s camera and LiDAR sensor to capture 3D scans of old headstones.
claims.source_title: I used ChatGPT to build an iPhone app for scanning historic headstones in 3D — and it actually worked
claims.supporting_quote: I have basically no programming experience, so I used ChatGPT/Work to build a simple iPhone app that uses the phone’s camera and LiDAR/depth data to capture headstones from multiple angles.
